name: Aleph-Alpha/Kolibri-1 model card
notes: Fetched 2026-10-17. Release date on the card is 3 October 2026. Nameplate: 78,103,074,560 total parameters, 3,457,573,120 active per token, 1,048,576 context, Apache-2.0, FP8 e4m3 weights in 128x128 blocks. Hardware line on the card: model memory footprint ~78 GB (FP8 weights); minimum 2x A100 80 GB, 2x H100 SXM5, 1x H200, 1x B200 or 1x B300. The card own benchmark table (a vendor claim) includes MathArena AIME 2026 at 96 and Terminal-Bench 2.1 at 27.7, and the HF eval-results widget repeats those two. The linked tech report is https://aleph-alpha.com/downloads/tech-report.pdf.
